Chapter 998 13: Lord Qingfen (Please Subscribe)

"A sea? A sea entirely composed of Seeds of the Fierce Sun?"

Qing Envoy Shi Song stared at the crimson mirror surface, nearly convinced he was hallucinating.

Since when could the Seeds of the Fierce Sun—so painstakingly difficult to condense even a single one—appear in the form of a 'sea'?

Ever since Lord Qingfen received the decree from the Fierce Sun Ancient Kingdom, ruling over the Qingfen Domain, countless geniuses had been born in this expansive domain over the millennia.

The Ten Fierce Sun Geniuses, considered extraordinary within ranges spanning tens of thousands to millions of years, could directly enter into the ranks under Lord Qingfen.

Yet, when extending the timeline to tens of millions, hundreds of millions, or even eons, the Ten Fierce Sun Geniuses did not appear particularly dazzling.

According to Shi Song's knowledge, the most formidable genius in the history of the Qingfen Domain was none other than Lord Qingfen's eldest disciple Feng Wanxing.

Back then, prior to reaching five hundred years old, Feng Wanxing had condensed a total of seven hundred thirty-two Seeds of the Fierce Sun.

But now?

Shi Song stared blankly at the fiery red mirror and the Sea of Fierce Sun, a single wave crashing within it revealing dozens of Seeds of the Fierce Sun.

Then what about the entirety of the sea? How many Seeds of the Fierce Sun were there?

Three thousand?

Ten thousand?

Shi Song dared not imagine—this utterly exceeded his perception.

"This matter must be reported to Senior Brother immediately!"

Qing Envoy Shi Song forcibly steadied his nerves, deeply realizing that the scene before him was entirely beyond his ability to handle. His only option was to notify his senior brother as soon as possible.

In truth, even his Sovereign Realm senior brother would likely be incapable of dealing with such a monstrous prodigy capable of condensing so many Seeds of the Fierce Sun, but the matter must still pass through his senior brother.

Buzz.

In the next moment.

Qing Envoy Shi Song retrieved a crimson jade slip.

This was the communication tool exclusively for disciples under Lord Qingfen, enabling 'instant contact' within the Qingfen Domain.

"Senior Brother, I've discovered a Sea of Fierce Sun here at the Yu Family's place..."

Qing Envoy Shi Song carefully composed his message, altering his wording multiple times, doing his utmost to articulate the extraordinary experience he was currently facing.

...

"What's wrong with Lord Envoy?"

The Yu Family's several elders and leaders observed Qing Envoy Shi Song's peculiar state, but their concern remained faint.

They didn't probe further.

Most of their focus was directed toward the dire predicament looming over them.

The Dongyang Family had produced a Supreme Genius among the Ten Fierce Sun Geniuses—an exceedingly bad development for the Yu Family.

Even the slightest misstep could lead to the catastrophic eradication of their entire clan.

Thus, the Yu Family's Dao Realm elders had already begun considering the matter of transferring the clan's foundational hopes for survival.

After years of relentless conflict between the Yu Family and the Dongyang Family, their grievances were irreconcilable. Now that the Dongyang Family was rising to prominence, how could they possibly spare the Yu Family?

Hence, the Yu Family's elders had never entertained thoughts of surrender or negotiation.

Conversely, had a Supreme Genius emerged from the Yu Family among the Ten Fierce Sun Geniuses, they likewise would never have accepted surrender or negotiation from the Dongyang Family.

...

"That crimson mirror—can it probe the state of the Seeds of Fierce Sun within my body?"

Lin Yuan stood motionless, observing Qing Envoy Shi Song as he stared at the fiery red mirror with vacant intensity.

Just moments ago, Lin Yuan had distinctly felt a sensing presence, and each Seed of Fierce Sun within his body had responded.

By now, the Seeds of Fierce Sun within Lin Yuan's body had formed a complete cycle, akin to an integrated whole, making him acutely aware of even the slightest external disturbance.

"It seems he's already aware of how many Fierce Sun Seeds I've condensed." Lin Yuan considered Shi Song's reaction, his expression unfazed.

Six months ago, Lin Yuan had already condensed more than three thousand Seeds of Fierce Sun. The current number had exceeded ten thousand.

Reaching a total of ten thousand three hundred and sixty-three.

Such an astonishing quantity of Seeds of Fierce Sun condensed by an individual under five hundred years old—Lin Yuan had never heard of anything like it.

"But perhaps that's for the best."

Lin Yuan mused inwardly.

In the Qingfen Domain, as in other great domains, all exist under the eternal radiance of the Fierce Sun.

Unless Lin Yuan intended to remain forever hidden and stand opposite the Fierce Sun Ancient Kingdom, he could only choose to align himself with their factions, maximizing his own interests.

At least for now, Lord Qingfen was likely a Chaos Venerable-tier powerhouse, while the Fierce Sun Ancient Kingdom was unfathomable in its depths.

...

Dongyang Family.

The towering figure was currently being treated by several of the Dongyang Family's elders.

Dongyang Meng obediently stood to the side, while numerous Dongyang Family leaders below radiated expressions of reverence toward her.

As a Supreme Genius among the Ten Fierce Sun Geniuses, Dongyang Meng's successful entry into Lord Qingfen's ranks would bring unimaginable status and honor.

The entire Dongyang Family would benefit for countless millennia because of Dongyang Meng.

"Looking back, I wouldn't have needed to ambush and kill that Yu Yan." Dongyang Meng thought aimlessly to herself.

Had she not yet condensed her tenth Seed of Fierce Sun, preemptively eliminating Yu Yan of the Yu Family would have been a worthwhile strategy.

Yet now, as she had successfully condensed her tenth Seed of Fierce Sun, those actions seemed laughable by comparison.

In Dongyang Meng's mind, the disparity in their future statuses was now destined to be worlds apart.

"Why hasn't Shi Song returned yet?" The towering figure inquired inwardly.

He had instructed Shi Song to visit the Yu Family, merely as a formality. Could it be that Shi Song was now receiving the Yu Family's hospitality?

"Hmm?"

At that moment, the towering figure's expression shifted subtly as he retrieved a crimson jade slip—Shi Song had sent him a 'message' from his visit to the Yu Family.

"What happened?"

The towering figure frowned, puzzled as to why Shi Song would resort to using the communication slip. Shouldn't he have simply returned in person?

Although somewhat irritated, the towering figure still spared a trace of his consciousness to inspect the jade slip.

The message contained within was short, yet it caused the towering figure's expression to shift dramatically.
